description: Allmendhubel is the viewpoint above Mürren, a small summit terrace at about 1912 metres in the municipality of Lauterbrunnen. The roofs of Mürren sit far below, and the north walls across the valley are dark masses in broken cloud. The village street of Mürren is already published. There is no flower carpet and no fresh snow on the terrace. The Open-Meteo model is partly cloudy and cool, about 8°C, with a light wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
